Logs confirm identical mechanism: fresh 07-27-only logs (wipe erased history), claude turns fail UserLlmProviderAuthFailed text_len=39 ('Invalid API key . Fix external API key'), ZERO cc-switch log lines (silent-empty provider env read), spawn env only AIONUI_*.
